Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information.

This issue is only happening on my phone with the number 555-123-2002. I haven’t traveled recently, changed my SIM card, or switched devices. I haven’t seen any specific error messages, but my phone just says “No Service” at the top. Would you like me to check the status bar for any specific icons or settings?

I checked the SIM card status, and it says that no SIM card is detected in the phone. What should I do next?
I reseated the SIM card as you instructed and turned my phone back on. However, my phone still shows “No Signal” at the top, and I don’t see any signal bars. Is there something else I should try?
I’ve just completed the payment for the overdue bill. What should I do next to get my service restored?
I’ve restarted my phone as you suggested, but unfortunately, it still shows “No Signal” at the top and I don’t see any signal bars. Is there anything else I should try?
My SIM card is now detected and active. The network mode preference on my phone is set to “4G/5G preferred.” However, I’m still seeing “No Signal” at the top. What should I do next?
I checked my APN settings, and the current APN name is set to “broken.” I’m not sure if that’s correct. Should I reset the APN settings to default or change anything here?
After resetting the APN settings and rebooting my phone, I now see full signal bars and “5G” at the top. It looks like my service has been restored! Thank you for your help.
